name: YearsHK
description:
Enjoy YEARS products and services more efficiently anytime, 
anywhere with the YEARS mobile app. 
App Features: 
-Store locations and details
-Know where to find us
-Product Catalog browsing
-Get updated whenever there are great deals and new arrivals
-Delivery and Pickup orders 
-Allows order placements for collecting at stores or direct 
deliveries to your doorstep
-Exclusive memberships and VIP perks
-Earn loyalty points with each spending and redeem exclusive 
offers for a better deal 
-Customer profiles unified and associated with purchase records and 
favourites across website, mobile app and in-store 
-Retrieve your purchase records, favorited items and use 
redeemed coupons anywhere with no hassle
